note: Eval fixture, not live prices. Shaped like CatalogItem rows so format_catalog_text() indexes them exactly like catalog_sync does.

items.name: Fasting Blood Sugar (FBS)
items.description: Measures blood glucose after 8-10 hours of fasting. Used to screen for and monitor diabetes.

items.name: Post Prandial Blood Sugar (PPBS)
items.description: Measures blood glucose 2 hours after a meal. Used with FBS to check for diabetes.

detailsData.fasting: Sample taken 2 hours after a meal

items.name: HbA1c (Glycosylated Haemoglobin)
items.description: Shows your average blood sugar over the past 3 months. Used to diagnose and monitor diabetes.

items.name: Diabetes Screening Package
items.description: Fasting blood sugar, HbA1c and urine sugar in one package for diabetes screening.

items.name: Thyroid Profile (T3, T4, TSH)
items.description: Checks thyroid function with Total T3, Total T4 and TSH.

items.name: TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone)
items.description: Single test to screen thyroid function.

items.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
items.description: Counts red cells, white cells, platelets and haemoglobin. Screens for anaemia and infection.

items.name: Liver Function Test (LFT)
items.description: Checks liver health: bilirubin, SGOT, SGPT, ALP, albumin and total protein.

items.name: Kidney Function Test (KFT)
items.description: Checks kidney health: urea, creatinine, uric acid, BUN and electrolytes.

items.name: Lipid Profile
items.description: Measures total cholesterol, HDL, LDL, VLDL and triglycerides to assess heart risk.

items.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
items.description: Measures 25-hydroxy vitamin D to check for deficiency.

items.name: Vitamin B12
items.description: Measures vitamin B12 levels to check for deficiency.

items.name: Basic Full Body Checkup
items.description: Routine full body checkup covering blood count, sugar, lipids, liver, kidney and thyroid.

items.name: Advanced Full Body Checkup
items.description: Everything in the basic checkup plus vitamins, HbA1c, iron studies and cardiac risk markers.

items.name: Men's Health Checkup (40+)
items.description: For men over 40: diabetes, heart, liver, kidney, thyroid and PSA screening.

items.name: Antenatal Profile
items.description: Recommended tests during pregnancy.

items.name: Iron Studies
items.description: Serum iron, TIBC and transferrin saturation to check iron deficiency.

items.name: hs-CRP (High Sensitivity C-Reactive Protein)
items.description: Marker of inflammation and heart risk.

items.name: Urine Routine and Microscopy
items.description: Physical, chemical and microscopic examination of urine.

items.name: PSA (Prostate Specific Antigen)
items.description: Screens for prostate problems in men.
